<module id="fsm">
    <description>Detection circuit for a single-bit input IN using a Mealy FSM.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Input signal to be detected.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal to initialize the FSM.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a match condition.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State representing IDLE.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">State representing S1.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">State representing S2.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">State representing S3.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">State representing S4.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S5">State representing S5.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="next_state" type="reg" width_description="[3:0]">Next state register.</signal>
        <signal id="current_state" type="reg" width_description="[3:0]">Current state register.</signal>
        
        // State encoding
        parameter [3:0] IDLE = 4'b0000;
        parameter [3:0] S1 = 4'b0001;
        parameter [3:0] S2 = 4'b0010;
        parameter [3:0] S3 = 4'b0011;
        parameter [3:0] S4 = 4'b0100;
        parameter [3:0] S5 = 4'b0101;
        
        // Next state logic
        always @(*) begin
            case(current_state)
                IDLE: next_state = (IN == 1'b1) ? S1 : IDLE;
                S1: next_state = (IN == 1'b0) ? S2 : S1;
                S2: next_state = (IN == 1'b0) ? S3 : IDLE;
                S3: next_state = (IN == 1'b1) ? S4 : IDLE;
                S4: next_state = (IN == 1'b1) ? S5 : IDLE;
                S5: next_state = (IN == 1'b0) ? S2 : IDLE;
                default: next_state = IDLE;
            endcase
        end
        
        // Current state update logic
        always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
            if(RST) current_state <= IDLE;
            else current_state <= next_state;
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on changes in IN, CLK, or RST
        always @(IN or CLK or RST) begin
            // Check if RST is active
            if (RST) begin
                // Set MATCH to 0 when RST is asserted
                MATCH <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                // Update MATCH based on the current state
                case (current_state)
                    IDLE: MATCH <= 1'b0;
                    S1: MATCH <= 1'b0;
                    S2: MATCH <= 1'b0;
                    S3: MATCH <= 1'b0;
                    S4: MATCH <= 1'b0;
                    S5: MATCH <= 1'b1;
                    default: MATCH <= 1'b0;
                endcase
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
